description: Compact audit report for the independent exact Python K7 cap-three short-circuit verifier on the complete current K7 residue.

report_provenance.note: The original temporary JSON report disappeared after the local reboot. Runtime and top-level counts are retained from captured completion output; every decision and all derivable counters were independently reconstructed from the immutable tracked gzip.

implementation.method: For each graph, stop at the first K7 seed for which every eligible cover Z with |Z|<=3 fails an exact rule; for a seed that has a passing cover, stop at its first pass.
implementation.arithmetic: Exact graph operations and Python integer/Fraction arithmetic only; no floating-point geometric decision is used.

exact_graph_results.interpretation: The 95372 rejections are exact. The 17764 survivors are unresolved, not claimed realizable.

short_circuit_work.note: These are scheduling/work counters for the short-circuit reference, not standalone mathematical coverage counts.

full_C_crosscheck.replay_note: The fresh 24-thread foreground C replay reproduced the original ordered C TSV byte-for-byte. Cache-dependent support-node effort and elapsed time are intentionally excluded from deterministic comparison.

tests.sample_C_Python_crosscheck: PASS: 512 graphs, 852 seeds, 52577 covers, enhanced exact rejections 426, survivors 86
tests.full_archive_verifier: PASS with and without the optional exhaustive C TSV

trust: Candidate nonedges remain optional unit pairs. The archive records exact decisions from the frozen reference. Its full-row agreement with the independently implemented exhaustive C kernel checks both the graph quantifier result and first rejecting seed for every input graph.
